style.name: Maximalism
style.description: Maximalist design embraces abundance through layered color, pattern, imagery, and typography. A repeated motif or strong compositional anchor turns that richness into a coherent visual personality.

fonts.heading: Syne
fonts.rationale: A distinctive display face contributes personality while a steady sans gives complex compositions a readable foundation.

tips: Repeat colors or shapes to create continuity.
Keep one unmistakable focal point per section.
Leave quiet zones around functional controls.
avoid: Treating every element as the focal point.
Sacrificing reading order for visual density.
